title: MxAgile Task
description: Canonical concrete actionable implementation task. Canonical location: planning/tasks/TASK-NNN.yml. Primary key: ID. Consumed by build_artifact_index.py for IMPLEMENTED_BY edges (spec field).

ID.description: Stable unique identifier. Primary key in the artifact index. Must match filename stem (TASK-001.yml -> ID: TASK-001).

spec.description: Parent spec ID. Creates an IMPLEMENTED_BY edge in the artifact index: Spec -> Task. Required for full traceability.

req.description: Optional direct requirement references for supplementary traceability when a task addresses a requirement more directly than the spec relationship implies.

type.description: Primary Mendix artifact category this task creates or modifies.

action.description: Short description of what this task does. Used as display name in the artifact index. One line.

detail.description: Detailed implementation notes: what to build, constraints, considerations.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be completed before this task can start.

test.description: Acceptance test for this specific task.

role.description: Mendix user role used to test.

microflow.description: Fully qualified microflow name to inspect.

migrated_from.description: Source file path for migrated tasks (e.g., planning/checklists/W01-implementation-checklist.yaml).
